Name: Field Works
Author: ChiroxT
Description:
[quote][size=3]Summary:
[/size]This Mod helps you farming by giving you the ability to harvest crops, plant seeds and use fertalisers with 1 click.
Just hold Shift and Right-Click on your field.
Mixed seeds also can be any seed of the season.[/quote]


[size=4]"What does this mod do?[/size]
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url]'s mod called [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11019]Field Harvest[/url], I started work on a counterpart: Field Planting﻿
But the work remained hard ... I still had to fertilise each plot ... so that was added.
Then... I added harvesting as well... the result was this mod:

[color=#00ff00][size=5][b][u]Field Works[/u][/b][/size][/color]

How does it make farming easier?
* You can harvest all your crops at once... including those from seasonal seeds.
* You can plant all your seeds at once
* You can fertilise all your plots at once.
* You can get any crop of the current season from mixed seeds (unfortunately, due to the way [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48334523]Sonozuki[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3012]Better Mixed Seeds[/url] seem to work, it was not compatible).


[b][size=4]"How can I do this?"
[/size][/b]
Just hold Shift while right-clicking on your field :)
If there are harvestables ... you will get them.
If not, but you have seeds in your inventory that can be planted ... you will plant them.
You have no seeds, but you have fertalisers? Well, then they will be used...


[b][size=4]"3 clicks to harvest, plant and fertilise? No, thank you! That is too much"
[/size][/b]
No worries ... go to the config and set allTogether to "true" and it will do all 3 jobs with just 1 click!
You can also use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34250790]spacechase0[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and turn on "do all Jobs"!


[b][size=4]"But what about watering the crops?"
[/size][/b]Due to high demand, i also added the option to do watering too.
But this function is disabled by default.
You can turn it on in the configs.
[b][color=#dd7e6b]This still uses Stamina and requires to refill the Watering Can.
[/color][/b]

[b][size=4]"Wow! But there must be a something! What doesn't this mod do??"
[/size][/b]
Well ... It does not take away the feeling of selling your crops.
Nor does it take away any of the experience you would get in Vanilla.


[b][size=4]"Okay, but doesnt this already exist?"
[/size][/b]
Actually, that could be possible. As i stated, it was inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11019]Field Harvest[/url],
but i did not search for the other features this mod contains.
But even if all those feature exists in other mods, this is a collection of all 4 basic farm features in one mod.
More features will come, which might not be included to the other mods, like connecting fields with chosen objects.


[b][size=4]"Cool! What do I need to use your mod?"
[/size][/b]
Actually ... NOTHING, as I do not rely on anyone else's code. 😁
Only optional is the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to make the settings easier, but that is not needed.


[b][size=4]"DAMN! I have to check this out!!!"
[/size][/b]
Plans:
1.2: add connectors to configs so paths can be used for visual purpose and as a connector between 2 fields ... manipulation of exp-rates
1.3: adding manipulation of mixed-seed-drop-rates and conditional mixed seed planting (e.g. year: 2, Location: island)
